Card Q&A.q: If the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself blue, does this card’s inherited effect activate?

Effect: When you would play this card from your hand, if you have a blue Digimon in play, reduce the play cost of this card by 1.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] If you have a blue Digimon in play, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
